column3: NASB puts “for that Sabbath was a high day” in parentheses and adds “day.”
NASB follows the critical text; “has borne witness” is rendered “has testified.”
NASB lacks “of,” found only in some manuscripts; the quotation is in capitals.
NASB renders “behold on” as “look on”; the quotation is in capitals.
NASB follows the critical text; it renders “concealed” as “a secret one.”
NASB follows the critical text; “litras” is rendered “pounds weight.”
NASB renders “to prepare for burial” as “the burial custom.”
